name: RangeSlider
summary: A low and a high value on one track, such as a price range, with two thumbs that cannot cross.
useWhen: A filter with a low and a high bound: price, distance, dates by year
A window inside a range, such as working hours
Bounds people tune while watching results update
avoidWhen: Exact bounds that people know and want to type
Bounds far apart on a huge scale, where a drag cannot hit a value

size.description: Track 2, 4 and 6 px thick, thumb 12, 16 and 24 px in a target of 24 px, 24 px and the lg control height.

tone.description: The range fill and the thumb: the primary color the style uses on a surface.

step.description: Arrows move one step; PageUp and PageDown move ten.

label.description: Visible name above the track. Each thumb is named by thumbLabels.

showValue.description: Shows the formatted value at the end of the label row. Default true when there is a label.

unit.description: A unit after the number, in the value text and aria-valuetext: %, px, SAR.

formatOptions.description: Intl.NumberFormat options for the value text. Digits are always Western.

formatValue.description: Full control of the value text, aria-valuetext included.

marks.description: Ticks under the track: numbers, or { value, label } objects.

name.description: The form name, submitted as name[] with two values.

invalid.description: A danger tint on the track and aria-invalid on the thumb. Inside a Field it follows the Field.

disabled.description: Inside a Field it follows the Field.

rootProps.description: Props for the root element. className and style also go to the root. The ref goes to the start thumb.

value.description: Controlled low and high values. Pair with onValueChange.

onValueChange.description: Called with the pair on every change, while dragging too.

onValueCommit.description: Called with the pair once when a drag ends or a key changes a value.

thumbLabels.description: Required. The accessible name of the start and the end thumb.

minStepsBetweenThumbs.description: Steps that must stay between the thumbs.

a11y.role: slider, on each thumb (a Radix span). Each thumb has its own name, aria-valuenow and aria-valuetext.
a11y.focus: Each thumb is a tab stop, start then end. Focus shows the glow and a 2px ring around the drawn thumb.

keys.Tab: Moves focus to the start thumb, then the end thumb, then on
keys.Shift+Tab: Moves focus back, end thumb then start thumb
keys.ArrowRight, ArrowUp: Raise the value by one step. In right to left text ArrowLeft raises it.
keys.ArrowLeft, ArrowDown: Lower the value by one step. In right to left text ArrowRight lowers it.
keys.PageUp, PageDown: Raise or lower the value by ten steps
keys.Shift+ArrowRight: Moves by ten steps, as PageUp
keys.Home, End: Move the focused thumb as far as it can go: Home toward the minimum, End toward the maximum, stopping before the other thumb

a11y.announce: The thumb's own name (Minimum price), then aria-valuetext with the unit (200 SAR). The visible pair is aria-hidden.
notes: thumbLabels is required: two thumbs with one name cannot be told apart.
The keys move the focused thumb. A thumb stops minStepsBetweenThumbs steps before the other, and a drag stops at the other thumb (preserveThumbOrder), so they never cross.
Every drag has the key path (WCAG 2.5.7). Each thumb is a 24px target.
Values use Western digits in every language.
With a label, the root has role group and is named by it, so the label names the pair while each thumb keeps its own name.

en.label: A noun in sentence case: Price.
en.thumbLabels: A start and an end name with the noun: Minimum price, Maximum price; Start hour, End hour.

ar.label: اسم بدون تشكيل: السعر
ar.thumbLabels: اسم للبداية واسم للنهاية مع الاسم: أقل سعر، أعلى سعر

styles.studio: A thin overlay track, the range and thumb in the bright text color
styles.desk: The same track, the range and thumb in the yellow primary (a darker gold in Desk Light)

mistakes.wrong: Two Sliders for a low and a high value
Filtering on every onValueChange while dragging
